svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Estate as a 3D landscape (L0 Landscape, INC-2041)
svg.desc: Perspective 3D world of the whole production estate at ladder level L0. Six regions stand as raised plateaus on three dark continents; each plateau holds two to four cluster districts made of small buildings whose footprint encodes capacity and height encodes load. Everything is calm blue-grey except eu-west-1: its prod-eu-1 district glows Failing and a thin magenta beacon marks the probable origin psp-api. edge-eu-1 in eu-central-1 is a desaturated victim with a dashed ground ring, LON-DC2 is hatched Unknown (telemetry stale), and curved arcs carry cross-region traffic with red dashes on failing calls to the external psp-a. A translucent HUD shows the top bar, view switcher, layer chips, the Orbit · Map · Fly mode chip, an altitude ladder with L0 lit, a care queue for INC-2041 (about €38k/h at risk), a minimap, an orbit compass and the Time Ribbon.

g.text: Blast radius: 3 regions see checkout errors
eu-central-1 · gateway p99 2.9 s · downstream of ⊕
on-prem · 122 hosts blind · collector down 6 min
ap-northeast-1 · fills in ~9 h at current rate
visible from any orbit or altitude.
dashed ring: a symptom, not a cause.
Dashes = calls in flight; red only
on failing calls (to psp-a, from edge).
height = load. No colour unless health
